# @ainelo/form-engine — LLM Reference

React library for generating forms from a JSON structure. It handles conditional display, multi-step pagination, OTP verification, file uploads, repeat groups, and multilingual labels.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @ainelo/form-engine
```

## Basic usage

```tsx
import { FormEngine } from "@ainelo/form-engine";

<FormEngine
  form={formStructure}
  formId="my-form"
  onSubmit={(data) => console.log(data)}
  currentLang="fr"
  submitButtonText="Valider"
  paginationMode="bySection"
/>
```

---

## FormEngine props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `form` | `FormStructure` | yes | — | Complete form definition |
| `formId` | `string` | yes | — | Unique identifier for this form instance (used for persistence) |
| `onSubmit` | `(data: Record<string, any>) => void` | yes | — | Called when the form is submitted and valid |
| `currentLang` | `string` | no | `"fr"` | Active language code for multilingual labels |
| `submitButtonText` | `string` | no | `"Continuer"` | Label of the submit/next button |
| `paginationMode` | `"byFields" \| "bySection"` | no | `"byFields"` | Overrides `form.layoutOptions.paginationMode`. `"byFields"` groups fields N per page; `"bySection"` shows one section per page |

---

## FormStructure

The `form` prop is a `FormStructure` object:

```ts
{
  name: string;           // Form name
  provider: string;       // Author / provider
  description: string;    // General description
  status: "ACTIVE" | "INACTIVE";
  isDeclaration: number;  // 1 = official declaration, 0 = standard
  isTest: number;         // 1 = test form, 0 = production
  version?: string;
  createdAt?: string;     // ISO date
  updatedAt?: string;     // ISO date
  sections: Section[];
  theme?: FormTheme;
  layoutOptions?: FormEngineLayoutOptions;
}
```

### FormTheme

```ts
{
  primaryColor?: string;  // Hex color, e.g. "#008080"
}
```

### FormEngineLayoutOptions

```ts
{
  paginationMode?: "byFields" | "bySection";
  progressBarType?: ProgressBarType;
  headerOptions?: HeaderOptions;
  displayDeleteButton?: boolean;   // Show "clear all" button (default: true)
  containerStyles?: ContainerStylesOptions;
  mobileNavSticky?: boolean;       // If false, navigation buttons render inline on mobile (same as desktop). Default: true (fixed bottom bar on mobile).
}
```

> **`mobileNavSticky`:** when `true` (default), navigation buttons are fixed to the bottom of the screen on mobile, with a compensating `padding-bottom` on the form container. When `false`, the same inline layout used on desktop is applied at all screen sizes — useful when the form is embedded in a page that already manages scroll, or when the sticky bar would conflict with the host layout.

#### ProgressBarType

```ts
{
  type: "default_step" | "custom" | "pastel" | "linear" | "section_bubble" | "section_bubble_pastel";
  colors?: {
    background: string;  // e.g. "#e5e7eb"
    foreground: string;  // e.g. "#008080"
  };
  visible?: boolean;
}
```

> **Auto-hide rule:** regardless of `visible`, the progress bar is never rendered when there is only one visible section (or one step). This avoids displaying a meaningless "Section 1 / 1" indicator. No configuration needed — it is automatic.

#### HeaderOptions

```ts
{
  visible?: boolean;
  type: "default" | "custom";
  customHeader?: React.ReactNode;  // Used only when type === "custom"
}
```

#### ContainerStylesOptions

```ts
{
  mainContainer?: ContainerStyles;    // Outer container (sections + buttons)
  sectionContainer?: ContainerStyles; // Inner container (each section)
}

// ContainerStyles
{
  borderColor?: string;        // e.g. "#e5e7eb"
  borderWidth?: string | number; // e.g. "2px" or 2
  backgroundColor?: string;    // e.g. "#ffffff"
}
```

---

## Section

A `Section` groups form fields and can be conditionally displayed:

```ts
{
  sectionId: string;
  title?: string | { [lang: string]: string } | null;
  subTitle?: string | { [lang: string]: string } | null;
  isSpacer?: string;           // Visual separator hint
  position?: number;           // Display order
  formFields: FormField[];
  conditionalDisplay?: ConditionalDisplayGroup;
}
```

---

## FormField

Each field in `section.formFields`:

```ts
{
  formFieldId: string;        // Unique ID (UUID)
  fieldName: string;          // Technical key — used as the key in onSubmit data
  slug?: string;              // Human-readable key for URLs / UI
  fieldType: FieldType;       // See field types below
  label: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  response: ResponseInForm;   // Initial / default value
  selectOptions?: SelectOption[];
  validations?: ValidationRule[];
  position?: number;
  placeholder?: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  tooltip?: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  helpText?: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  example?: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  enableSearch?: boolean;              // Enable search in dropdown
  width?: "full" | "half";            // Grid layout — see below
  conditionalDisplay?: ConditionalDisplayGroup;
  repeatGroup?: FormRepeatGroup;
  repeatRule?: RepeatRule;
  fileToBucketManage?: FileToBucketManage;
  otpFormFieldExecOptions?: OTPFormFieldExecOptions;
  emailFormFieldExecOptions?: EmailFormFieldExecOptions;
  detailInfos?: DetailInfosConfig;
  dynamicFilterRule?: DynamicFilterRule;
  flattenOnSubmit?: boolean;           // Flatten field in final JSON (default: true for OTP)
}
```

### Field types (fieldType)

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `"text"` | Single-line text input |
| `"textarea"` | Multi-line text input |
| `"dropdown"` | Select dropdown (requires `selectOptions`) |
| `"radio"` | Radio buttons (requires `selectOptions`) |
| `"checkbox"` | Checkboxes (requires `selectOptions`) |
| `"date"` | Date picker |
| `"number"` | Numeric input |
| `"bool"` | Toggle / switch |
| `"file"` | Generic file upload |
| `"password"` | Password input |
| `"IMAGE"` | Image upload |
| `"VIDEO"` | Video upload |
| `"AUDIO"` | Audio upload |
| `"DOCUMENT"` | Document upload |
| `"PDF"` | PDF upload |
| `"VOICE"` | Voice recording |
| `"TIP_TAP_DOC_TEXT"` | Rich text editor (TipTap) |
| `"OTP"` | One-time password field (requires `otpFormFieldExecOptions`) |

### Grid layout — `width`

Fields are rendered inside a **2-column CSS grid** (`grid-cols-2` at `md` breakpoint, single column below).

| `width` value | Behaviour |
|--------------|-----------|
| `"half"` (default) | Occupies 1 column — two `"half"` fields placed consecutively share the same row |
| `"full"` | Spans both columns (`col-span-2`) — always takes the full row width |

**Rules:**
- Two consecutive `"half"` fields → side by side on `≥ 768px`, stacked on mobile.
- A lone `"half"` field with no pair → occupies the left column only (right column is empty).
- `"full"` always breaks to its own row regardless of what precedes it.
- The `width` property is **not** required; omitting it defaults to `"half"`.

**No extra Tailwind config required** — the lib uses only standard Tailwind breakpoints (`md:`, `lg:`).

**Example — 2 fields side by side then 1 full-width:**
```ts
{ fieldName: "prenom", width: "half", ... },  // row 1, col 1
{ fieldName: "nom",    width: "half", ... },  // row 1, col 2
{ fieldName: "email",  width: "full", ... },  // row 2, full width
```

### ResponseInForm (initial value)

```ts
{
  responseValue: string | string[] | number | number[] | boolean | File | File[] | null;
}
```

---

## SelectOption

Used in `dropdown`, `radio`, `checkbox` fields:

```ts
{
  value: string;
  label: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  points?: number;   // Score / weight
  icon?: string;     // Icon name or URL
}
```

---

## ValidationRule

```ts
{
  validationType?: ValidationType;
  value?: number | string | string[];   // Param for the rule (e.g. min length value)
  errMsg: string;                        // Error message shown to user
}
```

### ValidationType values

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `"required"` | Field must not be empty |
| `"minLength"` | Minimum character count (`value`: number) |
| `"maxLength"` | Maximum character count (`value`: number) |
| `"regex"` | Must match pattern (`value`: string) |
| `"email"` | Must be a valid email |
| `"number"` | Must be a valid number |
| `"fileSize"` | Max file size in bytes (`value`: number) |
| `"phone_number"` | Must be a valid phone number |
| `"fileType"` | Allowed MIME types (`value`: string[]) |

---

## ConditionalDisplayGroup

Controls visibility of a section or field based on other field values:

```ts
{
  rules: ConditionalDisplayRule | ConditionalDisplayRule[];
  logic?: "AND" | "OR";  // How to combine multiple rules (default: "AND")
}
```

### ConditionalDisplayRule

```ts
{
  fieldName?: string | string[];      // Target field(s) by technical key
  formFieldId?: string | string[];    // Target field(s) by UUID
  operator?: ConditionalOperator;
  value?: string | number | boolean | string[] | number[];
  numeric_compare_to?: number;        // For numeric aggregation comparisons
  typeComputation?: "SOMME" | "MULTIPLICATION"; // Aggregate multiple field values
}
```

### ConditionalOperator values

`"=="` | `"!="` | `">"` | `"<"` | `"IN"` | `"NOT IN"` | `"CONTAINS"` | `"NOT CONTAINS"`

**Example — show a field only when another field equals "yes":**
```ts
conditionalDisplay: {
  rules: { fieldName: "has_vehicle", operator: "==", value: "yes" },
  logic: "AND"
}
```

---

## FormRepeatGroup

A group of fields that can be repeated (e.g. list of persons):

```ts
{
  repeatGroupId: string;
  fieldName: string;
  label: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  minRepeats?: number;
  maxRepeats?: number;
  initialRepeats?: number;
  formFields: FormField[];
  position?: number;
  conditionalDisplay?: ConditionalDisplayGroup;
}
```

### RepeatRule (on a FormField)

```ts
{
  max?: number;
  min?: number;
  prefillEmpty?: boolean;  // Pre-fill one empty instance on initial render
}
```

---

## OTPFormFieldExecOptions

Required when `fieldType === "OTP"`:

```ts
{
  serverDns: string;              // e.g. "https://api.example.com"
  postApiEndPoint: string;        // e.g. "/api/otp/verify"
  payload?: Record<string, any>;
  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
  bearer?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  otpLength?: number;             // Number of digits (default: 6)
  linkedEmailFieldName?: string;  // fieldName of the email field that triggers OTP send
  sendOTPApiConfig?: {            // Config for initial OTP send (if different from verify)
    serverDns: string;
    postApiEndPoint: string;
    payload?: Record<string, any>;
    extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
    bearer?: string;
  };
  autoValidate?: boolean;         // Auto-submit when all digits filled (default: false)
  enableResend?: boolean;         // Show "Resend code" button (default: true)
  resendCooldownSeconds?: number; // Min seconds between sends (default: 60)
}
```

---

## EmailFormFieldExecOptions

On a `"text"` field with an email validation, to trigger OTP send automatically:

```ts
{
  triggerOTPSend?: boolean;
  linkedOTPFieldName?: string;
  otpSendApiConfig?: {
    serverDns: string;
    postApiEndPoint: string;
    payload?: Record<string, any>;
    extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
    bearer?: string;
  };
}
```

---

## FileToBucketManage

On file fields (`"file"`, `"IMAGE"`, `"VIDEO"`, etc.) to upload/delete via a bucket API:

```ts
{
  uploadOption: UploadOption;
  deleteOption: DeleteOption;
}

// UploadOption
{
  serverDns: string;
  postApiEndPoint: string;   // e.g. "/api/files/upload-file"
  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
  bearer?: string;
  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  onResponse?(response: Response): Promise<void>;
}

// DeleteOption
{
  serverDns: string;
  deleteApiEndPoint: string; // e.g. "/api/files/delete-file"
  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
  bearer?: string;
  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  onResponse?(response: Response): Promise<void>;
}
```

---

## DetailInfosConfig

Dynamically generate extra fields when a specific option is selected in `dropdown`, `radio`, or `checkbox`:

```ts
// On FormField.detailInfos
{
  [optionValue: string]: {
    formFields: FormField[];
    label?: string | { [lang: string]: string };
  };
}
```

**Example — show extra fields when "other" is selected:**
```ts
detailInfos: {
  "other": {
    label: "Précisez",
    formFields: [
      {
        formFieldId: "detail-1",
        fieldName: "other_detail",
        fieldType: "text",
        label: "Précision",
        response: { responseValue: "" }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

---

## DynamicFilterRule

Filter a dropdown's options based on another field's value:

```ts
{
  dependentFieldName: string;              // fieldName of the field this depends on
  filterType: "exact" | "hierarchical";
  dataSource: {
    type: "static" | "external";
    data: Record<string, { value: string; label: string | { [lang: string]: string } }[]>;
    endpoint?: string;                     // For external data source
  };
  transform?: {
    valueKey: string;
    labelKey: string;
  };
}
```

---

## Full minimal example

```tsx
import { FormEngine } from "@ainelo/form-engine";
import type { FormStructure } from "@ainelo/form-engine";

const form: FormStructure = {
  name: "Contact",
  provider: "Sublime World",
  description: "Simple contact form",
  status: "ACTIVE",
  isDeclaration: 0,
  isTest: 0,
  theme: { primaryColor: "#008080" },
  layoutOptions: {
    paginationMode: "bySection",
    progressBarType: { type: "linear", visible: true },
    displayDeleteButton: false,
  },
  sections: [
    {
      sectionId: "section-1",
      title: "Vos informations",
      formFields: [
        {
          formFieldId: "f-name",
          fieldName: "full_name",
          fieldType: "text",
          label: { fr: "Nom complet", en: "Full name" },
          response: { responseValue: "" },
          validations: [
            { validationType: "required", errMsg: "Le nom est requis" },
            { validationType: "minLength", value: 2, errMsg: "Minimum 2 caractères" }
          ],
          width: "half",
        },
        {
          formFieldId: "f-email",
          fieldName: "email",
          fieldType: "text",
          label: { fr: "Email", en: "Email" },
          response: { responseValue: "" },
          validations: [
            { validationType: "required", errMsg: "L'email est requis" },
            { validationType: "email", errMsg: "Email invalide" }
          ],
          width: "half",
        },
        {
          formFieldId: "f-subject",
          fieldName: "subject",
          fieldType: "dropdown",
          label: "Sujet",
          response: { responseValue: "" },
          selectOptions: [
            { value: "info", label: "Information" },
            { value: "support", label: "Support" },
            { value: "other", label: "Autre" },
          ],
        },
        {
          formFieldId: "f-message",
          fieldName: "message",
          fieldType: "textarea",
          label: "Message",
          response: { responseValue: "" },
          validations: [{ validationType: "required", errMsg: "Le message est requis" }],
          conditionalDisplay: {
            rules: { fieldName: "subject", operator: "!=", value: "" },
          },
        },
      ],
    },
  ],
};

export default function App() {
  return (
    <FormEngine
      form={form}
      formId="contact-form"
      onSubmit={(data) => console.log("Submitted:", data)}
      currentLang="fr"
      submitButtonText="Envoyer"
    />
  );
}
```
